svg.title: Pundoku — D3 foreground layers for Icon Composer
svg.desc: Production layers. Flat, opaque, full white, transparent background, no platform mask, no baked shadows/blurs/highlights. TWO groups that must become TWO Icon Composer layers (blot in depth group 1, droplet in depth group 2 at a lower opacity) — split this file in the design tool before importing, or export each group separately. Background is a gradient defined inside Icon Composer (see pd93-logo-round2.md, Layer sheet D3).
